title: Investigate delayed reels upload processing
prompt: Instapix users reported uploads stuck in processing yesterday. Investigate the last 24 hours of this synthetic dataset using the connected tools. Locate the affected region and interval, quantify queue depth and upload completion, inspect worker logs and deployment annotations, and explain whether processing recovered. Separate request acceptance from successful media processing.
expectations: Correlates worker health, queue backlog and upload completion.
Checks recovery and healthy regional controls.
